license: MIT repository license; authored annotations, not copied UD examples

sources.principle: Punctuation adjacent to a dependent unit attaches to that unit; terminal punctuation attaches to its highest projective content head.
Addressee occurrence attaches to its host utterance by vocative.

policy: Finite greeting-host fixture: Hi as root interjection, names as vocative dependents, friend/pal as supplied object context; punctuation is orthographic supervision only, never acoustic policy.
limitations: Addressed intent is deliberately supplied supervision, not inferable solely from a comma.
Hi+name can have non-vocative corpus analyses; original observed heldout counterexample remains a regression case.
Motivator Hello/Travis and all seven reserved combinations excluded from training.
Existing DEV/TEST are previously observed regression evaluations, not newly blind.
